hook: 6 Lawyers Just Made *Partner* or Counsel in One Day
dek: TKD promoted six attorneys across six practice areas, effective September 2026.

slides.label: What Happened
slides.text: Tarter Krinsky & Drogin promoted *six attorneys* across six different practice areas, effective September 1, 2026.

slides.label: New Partners
slides.text: Caitlin Delaney (International), Michelle Hagler (Landlord & Tenant) and Edwin Hernández García (Business Immigration) all moved from *counsel to partner*.

slides.label: New Counsel
slides.text: Robyn Jagroop (Real Estate), Chandler Sturm (IP) and Deanna Wolf (Labor & Employment) advanced from *associate to counsel*.

slides.label: The Firm
slides.text: TKD is a *bicoastal* midsize firm founded in 2001, now marking its 25th year with over 30 practice areas.

slides.label: Why Now
slides.text: Managing partner Alan Tarter says this group 'reflects the DNA' of the firm and will *lead the next generation*.

slides.label: Leadership Program
slides.text: TKD runs a program called *GOAL* (Go Out and Lead/Learn) to build leadership and career growth for attorneys.

slides.label: Who They Serve
slides.text: The firm advises clients from *startups* to Fortune 100 companies, emphasizing relationship-driven middle-market work.

slides.label: Why It Matters
slides.text: One new partner leads *Business Immigration*, work that directly shapes paths for immigrant founders and workers building in the U.S.

question: Partner or counsel: which title sounds bigger to you? One word.

caption_instagram:
Tarter Krinsky & Drogin (TKD) just promoted six attorneys to partner and counsel, one of the law firm's biggest moves heading into 2026, according to Legal Reader.

Three attorneys, Caitlin Delaney (International), Michelle Hagler (Landlord & Tenant) and Edwin Hernández García (Business Immigration), moved up from counsel to partner. Three more, Robyn Jagroop (Real Estate), Chandler Sturm (Intellectual Property) and Deanna Wolf (Labor & Employment), advanced from associate to counsel. The changes take effect September 1, 2026, and TKD says its GOAL (Go Out and Lead/Learn) program helped build their leadership skills along the way.

TKD is a bicoastal, midsize firm marking 25 years in business, serving everyone from startups to Fortune 100 companies. Promotions like these matter beyond the firm itself, especially in practices like business immigration, where the attorneys at the table directly shape outcomes for immigrant entrepreneurs and workers trying to build in the U.S.

Partner or counsel: which title sounds bigger to you? One word.
